shadowtweaks.title: Shadow Tweaks
shadowtweaks.warning.shadows_off: Entity shadows are turned off in your video settings — nothing here will have any effect until you turn them back on. If you use Sodium Extra, check its settings too.
shadowtweaks.option.mod_enabled.desc: Toggles the mod on or off. Shadows then look exactly like vanilla.
shadowtweaks.option.scale.desc: Size of every entity shadow. 1.00 is vanilla. 0.00 hides shadows entirely — which is actually cheaper than vanilla, because the whole shadow calculation is skipped. Vanilla caps the result at 32 blocks.
shadowtweaks.option.opacity.desc: How dark shadows are. 1.00 is vanilla, 0.00 makes them invisible.
shadowtweaks.option.distance.desc: How far away a shadow stays visible, in blocks. Vanilla fades every shadow out at 16 and that limit is hardcoded — raise it and distant mobs keep their shadow. Costs a little performance, since more entities get shadows at once.
shadowtweaks.option.show_players.desc: Shadows for players, including yourself in third person.
shadowtweaks.option.show_hostile.desc: Shadows for monsters — zombies, skeletons, creepers and anything else that spawns as a monster.
shadowtweaks.option.show_passive.desc: Shadows for animals, villagers, fish and other peaceful creatures.
shadowtweaks.option.show_items.desc: Shadows for dropped items and experience orbs. Turning this off is the biggest win on a floor full of loot.
shadowtweaks.option.show_other.desc: Shadows for everything that is not a mob, player or item — boats, minecarts, armor stands, projectiles, primed TNT.
